title: MCX Webhook Event
description: Envelope for all events propagated from the MCX registry to subscribed buyers. Specific event types are differentiated via the 'type' field.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event delivery. Idempotency key — subscribers may receive duplicates and should dedupe on this field.

type.description: The event type. Subscribers may filter on this.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred at the source registry.

schema_version.description: MCX schema version of the disclosure this event refers to.

disclosure_id.description: ID of the disclosure record this event relates to.

publisher_name.description: Name of the organisation that published the disclosure record.

disclosure_url.description: URL to retrieve the current full disclosure record via the registry API.

payload.description: Event-type-specific payload. Shape depends on event type — see schemas/events/types.md for per-type definitions and human-readable trigger semantics.

disclosure_published.description: Fired the first time a disclosure record is published.

disclosure_updated.description: Fired on any change to an existing disclosure record. fields_changed lists modified top-level fields.

disclosure_expired.description: Fired when a disclosure record passes its review-by date without update.

risk_class_changed.description: Fired when a model's EU AI Act risk classification changes.

conformity_changed.description: Fired when conformity assessment or CE marking status changes.

training_data_changed.description: Fired when training data sources, scope, or cutoff are materially updated.

incident_reported.description: Fired when a serious incident under Article 73 is reported.

access_granted.description: Fired when a vendor grants a buyer access to a gated disclosure record.
